1.text: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake

2.text: And the earth discharges its burdens<sup foot_note="228265">1</sup>

3.text: And man says,<sup foot_note="228266">1</sup> "What is [wrong] with it?" -

4.text: That Day, it will report its news

5.text: Because your Lord has inspired [i.e., commanded] it.

6.text: That Day, the people will depart<sup foot_note="228267">1</sup> separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.

footnotes.228267: - From the place of Judgement to their final abode. Another interpretation is "emerge separately" (from the graves) .

7.text: So whoever does an atom's weight<sup foot_note="228268">1</sup> of good will see it,

footnotes.228268: - Or "the weight of a small ant."

8.text: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
